title: GC LLM as-generated evaluation contract
purpose: Score all 756 original outputs without editing, clipping, deduplicating, filtering, extending, or regenerating any answer.
interpretation: As-produced output-quality comparison; 305 outputs hit the 1024-token limit, often due to repetition. Evaluate unchanged and retain these flags for subgroup reporting. Fixed judge/rubric is comparable to Llama but generation configurations may differ. Provisional, pending calibration.
status_semantics: success in normalized ingestion means a nonempty generation was produced, not that the response was complete or correct. Retain response_complete/truncated/finish_reason in provenance for analysis.
constraints: Question alone to evaluated model (already generated)
Reference and supporting context are judge-only
Score only applicable primary and secondary metrics
No rewriting, deduplication, reruns, special prompt changes or skipping truncated/repeated answers
One distinct GC LLM research run, not the Llama run
Record user execution permission as required by research-run workflow; never impersonate approval
